title: Learning to arrange
summary: Arranging for Celestin's larger band with help from Cecil Thornton, Fats Pichon and a correspondence course.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Worthwhile doing. And while I was with Solid Stan's band, I did some of the arranging. We had, when he developed the larger band, we had Cecil Thornton, he was arranging. Fats Pichon did quite a bit of arranging for the band. In fact, Pichon really instructed me. I took a course from Archie Bly, a correspondence course from Archie Bly on arranging. And Fats Pichon coached me along with that. And Cecil Thornton helped me out quite a bit. And I learned to write some.
